metadata.task: If the wheelchair is available near reception, move it to Room 102; otherwise bring the walking aid.

plan.goal: Transport a mobility aid (wheelchair or walking aid) from the Reception area to Room 102.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Detect and locate the nearest available mobility aid (wheelchair or walking aid) at the Reception zone.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at Main Entrance or Reception. No specific mobility aid is held. World state contains Reception zone with potential mobility aids.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has identified the location and type of the nearest available mobility aid (either a wheelchair or a walking aid) at the Reception zone.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot uses its visual perception to detect objects in the current scene. This skill identifies the presence of objects like wheelchairs or walking aids.
After detecting the object, the robot classifies it to distinguish between a 'wheelchair' and a 'walking aid'.
The robot determines the precise pose of the detected mobility aid within the Reception zone to plan the subsequent transport.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the location of the detected mobility aid.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot has identified the location of the mobility aid (wheelchair or walking aid) at the Reception zone.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has successfully navigated to the pose adjacent to the mobility aid at the Reception zone.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot navigates to the pose of the detected object (mobility aid) using the Nav2 navigation stack.

checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the location of the mobility aid (wheelchair or walking aid).
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has successfully grasped the mobility aid.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot uses MoveIt2 to plan and execute a grasp trajectory to pick up the mobility aid.

checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the mobility aid at the Reception zone.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has navigated to the location of Room 102.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot navigates to the semantic location 'Room 102' using the Nav2 navigation stack.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the mobility aid in Room 102.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the mobility aid at Room 102.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has placed the mobility aid in Room 102 and is free.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot uses MoveIt2 to plan and execute a placement trajectory to release the mobility aid at the target pose in Room 102.

constraints: Robot must have can_pick capability to handle the mobility aid.
Robot must have can_navigate capability to move between zones.
Robot must have can_transport capability to carry the object.
Robot must have can_detect_objects capability to find the aid.
Robot must have can_detect_humans capability to avoid collisions with staff/patients.
Robot must have can_grasp capability to secure the object.
Robot must have can_place capability to deposit the object.
Robot must have supports_indoor_navigation capability for hospital environment.
Robot must have supports_obstacle_avoidance capability for crowded hospital corridors.
Robot must have supports_localization capability for navigation.
Robot must have single_arm_only constraint (no two hands), but can_pick/can_transport are true.
Robot must have limited_payload constraint (must ensure mobility aid fits).

execution_summary.expected_outcome: The robot will detect a mobility aid at Reception, pick it up, navigate to Room 102, and place it there, completing the task.
